final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Alerts (2026-05-18 15:26~15:28) show LATENCY_DEGRADATION on frontend (p50 20.45ms -> 3740.67ms), recommendationservice (p50 3.05ms -> 3730.77ms) and productcatalogservice (p90 2.13ms -> 4003.98ms). GetServiceDependencies proves productcatalogservice is the leaf (upstream: frontend, checkoutservice, recommendationservice; downstream: None), so caller latency propagates from it. Code surface: GetSourceCode(product_catalog.go) shows the ListProducts handler contains an injected blocking sleep 'time.Sleep(time.Millisecond * time.Duration(3000))' after 'time.Sleep(extraLatency)'. GetAppYAML confirms EXTRA_LATENCY is not set (extraLatency=0), so the literal 3000ms sleep is the only latency source; cpu limit 200m/128Mi and probes are normal. Resource/health face is clean: all 11 pods are 2/2 Running with RESTARTS 0 (productcatalogservice-658ddd988c-ngzdz), GetErrorLogs returns no error logs (pure delay, no errors), and namespace events show no OOM/Evicted/FailedScheduling/FailedMount/quota Warning for productcatalogservice - only transient rollout probe 503s. A blocking sleep burns no CPU, so the resource face reads clean while the code surface carries the defect line.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: productcatalogservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: productcatalogservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: productcatalogservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
        image: wangyl2128/productcatalogservice-v2:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3550
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "3550"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: productcatalogservice
  ports:
  - name: grpc
    port: 3550
    targetPort: 3550

kind: ServiceAccount
